what: Primo Brands sells bottled water in North America: Poland Spring, Deer Park, Arrowhead, Ozarka and Pure Life, plus the Primo water dispensers and refill stations, formed by merging Primo Water with BlueTriton.
customers: American and Canadian households and businesses, through supermarkets, delivery and dispensers.
money: regional spring water brands sold in shops
home and office water delivery and exchange
moat: Spring sources with water rights, regional brands shoppers recognise, and a delivery network to homes and offices that would cost enormously to rebuild.
risks: $5.7B of debt against $377M of cash, from the merger
A 0.9% net margin while merger costs are absorbed
Water is heavy and freight costs are a large part of the cost base
opportunities: $414M of free cash flow and revenue up from $5.2B to $6.7B as the merger completed
Analysts see about 22% upside, with 11 covering the stock
Merging the two largest American water businesses creates cost savings that have barely begun
watch: Merger cost savings delivered and organic volume growth.
